## Summary

Describe the focused problem and the change.

## Validation

- [ ] `gradle lint testDebugUnitTest assembleDebug assembleRelease`
- [ ] Relevant behavior tested on an Android device/emulator where applicable
- [ ] No signing keys, tokens, cookies, account exports or private content added

## Compatibility / security impact

Describe changes involving Android versions, System WebView versions, Misskey compatibility, navigation, cookies, downloads, TLS, WebView profiles, permissions or injected JavaScript/CSS.

## Measurement

For battery/performance claims, include reproducible A/B evidence or explain why measurement is not applicable.

## User-facing changes

Note documentation/changelog changes and any migration or update impact.
